## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmation: weak overall breadth (3/11) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Top performers in Tech), plus defensives are not leading.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND.  
Technology shows pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials weak: FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND.  
Healthcare soft: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND; MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND; UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Materials and parts of Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; note major divergence among large caps — MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -8.49%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY — MAJOR Divergence, tactical uncertainty.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with concentrated rallies and idiosyncratic winners; INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND contrast with AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -4.25% | 1M: -10.37%) BELOW TREND. Sector showing pockets of accumulation but narrow leadership; sector overall positive this week per sector summary.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are soft: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, though idiosyncratic news (WFC +80) could drive dispersion — sector breadth weak (20 stocks cited).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure overall with LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND and mixed leadership; PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION has bullish news (+75) but near-term price is soft — watch for confirmation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Given CAUTION and narrow Tech leadership, reduce exposure to concentrated, high-beta names and favor selective Energy and resilient large-caps (MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND). Monitor major-cap divergences (MSFT RECOVERY, AMZN RECOVERY) and news-driven names (PFE, INTU) for tactical entries.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — news-confirmed; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND; MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.83%, 10 stocks) for sector leadership and confirmation.  
BEARISH: Materials (1W: -6.92% | 1M: -5.40%, 11 stocks) and Consumer Staples (1W: -5.38% | 1M: -2.76%, 14 stocks) as risk areas.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND holding short-term support for a broader risk pivot; AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim 1M momentum keeps it at risk; INTU closing strength (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) is a near-term trigger for Tech sentiment; MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) continuation would reinforce Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTU (+65): INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — news (Q2 beat, Anthropic deal) confirms price strength.  
PFE (+75): PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — bullish news but near-term price weakness is a divergence to monitor.  
DOW (+50): DOW (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +3.93%) ABOVE TREND — JPMorgan upgrade and price action are confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MNST (-55): MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND — earnings-driven sell-off confirmed.  
BA (-55): BA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY — negative headlines but price shows short-term recovery, monitor for further downside.  
AMGN (-55): AMGN (news -55) — sector-level watch; check price action for confirmation (noting healthcare softness).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak breadth.  
INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength.  
Key risk: major-cap divergence (MSFT RECOVERY, AMZN RECOVERY, MA RECOVERY) and bullish news on PFE (+75) despite near-term price weakness — watch for trend breaks.
